name: simset-glass-004
description: You want to form an amorphous glass by melting a crystal, equilibrating at high temperature, then quenching to low temperature and relaxing. Multiple ensemble sequences can be scientifically reasonable depending on your protocol (e.g., whether you allow box relaxation during quench or try to minimize barostat artifacts).
